v2.name: NASDAQ-100
v2.rationale: NDX capitulation is read as a momentum-factor unwind plus a vol event: MTUM's drawdown from its 1y high carries the most weight (it starts in 2013, so its weight is set on 2013-19 and tested on 2020-26), with the absolute VIX level, daily RSI14, the equity put/call percentile and the index's own drawdown confirming. VXN percentile, VRP, VIX term structure, VVIX/VIX, HY OAS and the trend score all test positive alone but add nothing to this combination in-sample, so they are out. Capitulation building is the top decile of the composite in 2001-13, Flush the top 2%.
v2.rationale_recovery: ONE recovery set for all indices, FIXED by reasoning and equal-weighted, not fitted: implied vol off its 20d peak and realized vol compressing (the fear is leaving the tape), VIX term structure back below one (the front is no longer bid), price back above the 20dma, the trend score turning up from strong-down, and the put/call ratio off its peak (US only). Turning = at least half of them on inside a capitulation episode (from a dip or from a flush; the card says which). Why fixed: with 5-16 flushed episodes per index per half a fitted set flipped with every change to the episode definition, and the pooled evidence is one-sided in time — in the long 2001-02 and 2008-09 bears no tell beat simply buying the flush, while in 2013-26 each of these cut the 63d drawdown by 3-7 points against the episode onset. MACD turn and the 2d rally gain nothing in either half; reclaim of the 50dma is right but ~30 days late; RSI divergence fires in a quarter of flushes; the Korea flow trigger fires in 3 flushes in 25 years.

v2.name: KOSPI 200
v2.rationale: Korea is read on its OWN tape, not global vol: the VKOSPI level, the one-day crash flush, RSI14 and the strong-down trend score share the weight; drawdown, VRP, KRW stress and the foreign-flow washout were candidates and add nothing to the mix. The old flow trigger was tested as a recovery tell and fires in too few episodes to measure, so it is not in the composite.
